cards.name: Chase Sapphire Reserve
cards.rewards_summary: 8X points on travel booked through Chase Travel; 4X points on flights and hotels booked direct; 3X points on dining worldwide. $300 annual travel credit, up to $500 annual Edit by Chase Travel hotel credit (up to $250 per prepaid 2-night booking), Priority Pass Select + Chase Sapphire Lounge access (enrollment required).
cards.note: Intro offers omitted as too volatile — verify current terms on the issuer's site before applying. High fee only pencils out if you use the major credits; verify against your own travel habits.

cards.name: Citi Custom Cash Card
cards.rewards_summary: 5% cash back on purchases in your top eligible spend category each billing cycle (up to the first $500 spent, then 1%); 1% cash back on all other purchases. No categories to pick or activate — the card adjusts automatically. Earns ThankYou points.
cards.note: Intro offers omitted as too volatile — verify current terms on the issuer's site before applying. The 5% only applies to one category per cycle, capped at $500 in spend.

cards.name: Capital One Savor
cards.rewards_summary: 3% back on dining, groceries (excluding superstores), entertainment, and popular streaming services; 5% on hotels and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel; 8% on Capital One Entertainment purchases; 1% on all other purchases. No foreign transaction fees.

cards.name: Bank of America Customized Cash Rewards

cards.note: Verify current terms on the issuer's site before applying.

cards.name: Capital One Quicksilver
cards.rewards_summary: Unlimited 1.5% cash back on every purchase; 5% on hotels, vacation rentals, and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel. No foreign transaction fees.
cards.note: Verify current terms on the issuer's site before applying.

cards.name: U.S. Bank Cash+ Visa Signature
cards.rewards_summary: Earn 5% cash back on two categories you choose each quarter (first $2,000 in combined purchases per quarter; quarterly enrollment required), 2% on one everyday category such as gas/EV charging, grocery, or restaurants, and 1% on everything else. 5% also on prepaid travel booked through the U.S. Bank Rewards Center.
cards.note: Verify current terms on the issuer's site before applying.

cards.name: Bilt Blue Card
cards.rewards_summary: 1x Bilt points on everyday purchases, with an option to earn 4% Bilt Cash on non-housing spending instead. Earn up to 1.25x Bilt points on rent, mortgage, and HOA payments made through the Bilt app with no transaction fee (rate scales with everyday card spending). Bilt points transfer to airline and hotel partners. No foreign transaction fees.
cards.note: The original Bilt Mastercard (Wells Fargo) was retired in February 2026; the current Blue card is issued by Cardless. Terms change — verify current terms on the issuer's site before applying.
